title: Jan van Riebeeck founds a Dutch station at the Cape
summary: Jan van Riebeeck arrived in Table Bay with three ships and set up a fort and garden to supply Dutch East India Company ships.
reason: Ships sailing between Europe and Asia needed fresh water, food and repairs halfway along the long voyage.
significance: The outpost grew into Cape Town and the start of European settlement in South Africa.
place: Table Bay, Cape Town, South Africa
